mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before scheduling a home addition consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before reaching out to a contractor, gather your property survey, identify your functional goals, determine a tentative budget, and review any HOA guidelines. A property survey or boundary plat shows easements and property boundaries, which reveal how close to the property line you can build. Define how the space will function—such as an extra bedroom, in-law quarters, or an extended living room—and whether it requires plumbing. Having this information upfront helps the contractor assess site viability, plan structural tie-ins, and provide an accurate initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, outline your functional space needs and budget, check HOA rules, and determine whether the addition requires plumbing for a bathroom or kitchen.
